findings.title: Version-control directory exposed
findings.description: '.git/config' is reachable (HTTP 200); a VCS directory can leak source code, history and secrets.
findings.recommendation: Block access to VCS directories and never deploy them to production.

findings.title: Environment / secrets file exposed
findings.description: '.env' is reachable (HTTP 200) and may contain credentials, API keys or other secrets.
findings.recommendation: Remove the file from the web root and rotate any exposed secrets.

findings.title: Configuration file exposed
findings.description: 'wp-config.php' is reachable (HTTP 200); configuration files may reveal credentials and internal settings.
findings.recommendation: Move configuration outside the web root and deny direct access.

findings.title: Backup / dump file exposed
findings.description: 'backup.zip' is reachable (HTTP 200); backups and dumps often contain source code or database contents.
findings.recommendation: Remove backup/dump artefacts from the web root.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline'
findings.description: The CSP directive 'default-src' allows 'unsafe-inline', which largely defeats the protection against inline-script XSS.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' and use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline'
findings.description: The CSP directive 'script-src' allows 'unsafe-inline', which largely defeats the protection against inline-script XSS.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' and use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.

findings.title: CSP uses a wildcard source
findings.description: The CSP directive 'default-src' allows a wildcard '*' source, which permits loading from any origin.
findings.recommendation: Replace '*' with an explicit allow-list of trusted origins.

findings.title: Development / metadata file exposed
findings.description: 'composer.json' is reachable (HTTP 200) and can leak internal information.
findings.recommendation: Remove development and metadata files from production.

findings.title: No clickjacking protection
findings.description: Neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive is present, so the page can be framed by third parties (clickjacking).
findings.recommendation: Set 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or a CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive.

findings.title: Cookie without HttpOnly flag
findings.description: Cookie(s) session lack the 'HttpOnly' flag and are reachable from JavaScript, increasing the impact of XSS.
findings.recommendation: Add 'HttpOnly' to cookies that do not need JS access (e.g. session).

findings.title: Cookie without SameSite attribute
findings.description: Cookie(s) session have no explicit 'SameSite' attribute, weakening CSRF defences.

findings.title: CSP has no base-uri
findings.description: No 'base-uri' directive is set, allowing injected <base> tags to redirect relative URLs.

findings.title: Software version disclosed in headers
findings.description: Header 'server: Apache/2.4.52 (Unix) PHP/8.1.2' discloses a component and its version, helping attackers target known vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Software version disclosed in headers
findings.description: Header 'x-powered-by: PHP/8.1.2' discloses a component and its version, helping attackers target known vulnerabilities.

findings.title: No MIME-sniffing protection
findings.description: X-Content-Type-Options is not set to 'nosniff', so browsers may interpret responses as a different content type than declared.

findings.title: No Referrer-Policy
findings.description: No Referrer-Policy is set; full URLs may leak to third-party sites.

findings.title: robots.txt reveals sensitive paths
findings.description: robots.txt disallows paths that hint at sensitive areas: /admin/, /backup/, /config/.
findings.recommendation: Do not rely on robots.txt to hide sensitive paths; protect them server-side.

findings.title: No Permissions-Policy
findings.description: No Permissions-Policy header; browser features (camera, geolocation, etc.) are not explicitly restricted.
findings.recommendation: Declare a Permissions-Policy that disables unused features.
